advancing_view.reason: Pre-outer inner-only decision prioritized target separation, instrument invariance, same-master geometry, and corruption stability. Minimal remains mandatory because it reconstructs clean spectra and repeatable peaks more faithfully.

claim_limits: No model solved the 98-spectrum field-quality stress cohort.
No AE passed the predeclared absolute repeatable-peak gate.
Unsupported unseen analyte classes are excluded from supported-class metrics and reported separately.
Synthetic denoising success is not evidence of universal real-domain denoising.

classical_reference.decision: PCA-logistic is the primary clean classification reference.

denoising.decision: DAE adds substantial synthetic composite-corruption recovery and latent stability, but does not consistently improve clean, real-stress, or unseen-domain classification.

deterministic_reconstruction.decision: Clean AE is a useful matched compression/reconstruction diagnostic but does not outperform the classical clean reference and fails the absolute repeatable-peak gate.

reproducibility.reason: CUDA-trained checkpoint tensors reproduce exactly, but separate-process CUDA convolution inference showed approximately 1e-7 to 1e-5 floating variation. CPU replay from verified checkpoints is the canonical bitwise-stable evaluation layer.

siamese.decision: Retain as deterministic metric-learning control; it does not provide reconstruction or explicit denoising and is not the strongest NATO classifier.
